hyperedges.label: Practice Session Lifecycle
hyperedges.description: useRecording drives mic init, countdown, recording, and stop; on stop it calls useScoring.buildSessionResult to derive scores, then calls useSession.saveFinishedSession (which calls practiceApi.saveSession and updateStreak) and useSession.requestFeedback (which calls practiceApi.analyzeSpeech and updateSession).

hyperedges.label: Google OAuth Auth Flow
hyperedges.description: AuthPage and SignUpPage both call useAuth().signInWithGoogle(); AuthContext handles the OAuth flow via supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth with PKCE redirect to /auth/callback which AuthCallbackPage handles by reading session from AuthContext.

hyperedges.label: Practice Panel State Flow
hyperedges.description: usePracticeState drives all practice panels through PracticeState lifecycle: setup → countdown → recording → finishing → done

hyperedges.label: Recording Controller Orchestration
hyperedges.description: useRecordingController composes useRecording, useScoring, useSession, and useAuth to orchestrate the full recording lifecycle

hyperedges.label: Stats API Consumers

hyperedges.label: API Quota Guard Pattern
hyperedges.description: Quota enforcement: consumeApiQuota calls Supabase RPC, throws ApiQuotaExceededError, caught in handleVoiceMessage before Groq calls

hyperedges.label: Flow Score Computation Pipeline
hyperedges.description: The Flow Score pipeline involves the frozen formula in scoring.ts, the fixed 1.2s pause threshold, Groq-primary word-timestamp pause detection, and exposes a known divergence between the web (RMS) and Telegram (word-gap) measurement methods.

hyperedges.label: Security Boundary: RLS + Server-Only Keys + Auth Redirect
hyperedges.description: The app's security model relies on Supabase RLS, server-only service-role keys, and safe auth redirects. The audit reveals critical gaps: sessions/streaks tables may lack RLS, and auth callback allows protocol-relative redirect bypass.

hyperedges.label: PWA Brand Asset Set
hyperedges.description: All NoPause brand assets share the same design: gold speech-bubble icon with audio waveform bars on a dark navy background. The favicon, 192px icon, 512px icon, and OG preview image collectively form the app's visual identity and are referenced by the PWA manifest and index.html.
